Small thin loop-shaped radiopaque objects lie near both sides of the image at the level of the temporomandibular regions. A well-defined rounded dark area is visible in the lower right portion of the image within the mandibular body. The remaining mandibular bone appears more uniformly gray than in the first figure. No letters, numbers, arrows or scale are visible.

visual.general_description: Pink and purple stained microscopy image of a curved epithelial band over pale connective tissue.
visual.detailed_description: Light microscopy image with pink and purple staining; the stain is not named in the caption. A curved band of epithelium runs across the upper part of the image, several cell layers thick, with a thin pink surface layer on top. The cells in the lowest layer along the epithelial border are darker purple and lined up side by side. Beneath the band is pale pink connective tissue with scattered small purple nuclei and a few thin fibres. A few tiny dark brown specks lie in and near the epithelium. No scale bar, labels or arrows are visible.
